notes.title: Update 1.2 "The Tower of Trials" Now Live!
notes.content:
Heya fellow deer enthusiasts!

The second content update for Ronny's Climb has just arrived on Steam, and it's available to play right now! Alongside some general improvements, this update, "The Tower of Trials," introduces an entirely new bonus stage complete with new Steam achievements to unlock, 100 gems to collect, and another par time ready for you to beat!

This update is meant as a token of appreciation for the most dedicated players who've gone above and beyond by achieving a full 100% completion of the main storyline. Once your statistics screen indicates 100% overall completion, the new stage will appear on your Stage Select screen. This new level is also significantly harder than the others and will hopefully prove to be a suitable challenge for those who have already mastered Ronny's Climb. For those still climbing towards 100%, I've adjusted a few par times to make your ascent a little smoother. As always, you can find the full patch notes below.



I sincerely hope you have as much fun conquering this new stage as I had creating it!

Zephyrix <3



P.S.: To celebrate this update, Ronny's Climb is also 30% off for two weeks. Also, did you know we recently set up a Pixel Platformer bundle including both Ronny's Climb and Unless? If you already own Ronny's Climb, you can get Unless at a 10% discount. It's a beautiful game, definitely check it out if you haven't!


Changelog:
Added a new bonus stage called "The Tower of Trials" complete with 100 gems and new badges to collect. "The Tower of Trials" is a reward for achieving 100% completion of the main storyline. Once your statistics screen shows 100% overall completion, "The Tower of Trials" will appear on the Stage Select screen. This stage is meant as a challenge dedicated to those who have mastered the game and hence is significantly harder than the other levels.

Made the par times for "Crystal Caverns", "The Summit" and "Finale" slightly easier to beat.

Crumbling ground now reappears after a few seconds.

Some sound effects now sound less repetitive when played often.

The teleporter in "Treetop Trails" now has a sound effect.

Fixed a bug where crumbling ground would continue to crumble while the game was paused.

notes.title: Update 1.1 "Retro Ridgeclimb" Live
notes.content:
Heya everyone,

Steam Spring Sale has just started, and with the start of the sale, I've also released the first major update to Ronny's Climb which you can play right now! Update 1.1 named "Retro Ridgeclimb" comes with a new secret stage complete with new achievements to unlock, as well as customizable keybindings, support for Steam Deck and other exciting changes. Find the full patch notes below.

As always, thanks a bunch for your support following the release of Ronny's Climb. It's been an exciting time. If you own a Steam Deck, I'd really appreciate if you could try and run the game on it and give me feedback in case something isn't working.


Unlocking "Retro Ridgeclimb"
Similar to "Balloon Bonanza", the new stage is a secret level as well and you'll need a code to unlock it first. Here are some hints for finding it:

Hint 1: [spoiler]The code for "Retro Ridgeclimb" is hidden in stage 3.[/spoiler]

Hint 2: [spoiler]To find the code, you'll have to climb the very top of the desolate tower at the end of stage 3. You can reach the ledge with a dash or with help from the dragonflies.[/spoiler]


Have a wonderful day

Zephyrix <3


Changelog:

 A new secret stage called "Retro Ridgeclimb" has been added to the game, including new Steam achievements for collecting all 100 gems, beating the timer and obtaining the two badges in the new stage
 Keybindings are now fully customizable both for keyboard and joypad
 "Balloon Bonanza" now has new visuals and its own new musical track
 Ronny's Climb is now available for Linux and a dedicated build for Steam Deck has been added as well
 Made various minor adaptations in some stages to make certain jumps less frustrating
 Fixed an issue where a block in "Balloon Bonanza" could be moved to a place where it would make accessing some gems impossible
 Fixed a typo in "Emerald Vale"

notes.title: Ronny's Climb now supports Steam Cloud
notes.content:
Heya everyone,

I have just activated Steam Cloud saves for Ronny's Climb. If everything went well, you shouldn't see any immediate impact—all your savegames and options should hopefully still be there, and now they will also be synched over multiple devices!

A word on the Steam Deck

Ronny's Climb doesn't officially support the Steam Deck at the moment (mainly as I don't own a Steam Deck myself, so testing for it is difficult). Also, Ronny's Climb is a small game and Valve doesn't allow me yet to even apply for the 'Steam Deck Verified' badge. That being said, apparently the game runs fine on the Steam Deck as is, using Proton for compatibility. Some players have reported graphics bugs in the menu or Steam achievements not working as intended though.

In order to fix these issues and to provide actual Steam Deck support, I will add a dedicated Linux and Steam Deck build soon™. However, I don't exactly know how the savegames interact between the Proton emulation and an actual Linux/SteamOS build. While I said I don't really support the Steam Deck yet, I also don't want anyone who has played Ronny's Climb on it to lose their save file.

Hence, what I recommend is that if you have been playing exclusively on the Steam Deck and if you want to avoid risking your save file, that you run the game once in the next few days to ensure Steam uploads your save to the Steam Cloud. Once I provide a dedicated build for the Steam Deck, I hope Valve's Steam Cloud feature will take care of everything.

Should you ever lose your save file due to issues with the newly activated Steam Cloud feature or during the transition from Proton emulation over to the Linux/SteamOS build, please contact me and I will help you restore your progress to the best of my ability.

Zepyhrix <3

New option: "Fast Textboxes". Setting this option to ON will cause dialog text to appear instantaneously.

notes.title: Update 1.0.8 - Skippable Dialogs
notes.content:
Added a way to skip dialog so that players who are speedrunning or replay levels for badges don't need to sit through mandatory conversations. Use  for keyboard and  for Controller to skip the current dialog immediately.
 Made the credits scene more beautiful with some animations (if you have seen the credits before, you can replay them by beating the finale again using the 'Continue' option instead of 'Stage Select')
 Jumping on bats in the finale will now always propel the player highly whether they hold the jump button or not. This should support players who are not aware that holding jump while jumping on monsters will cause them to jump higher.

 Added another mention in the credits

notes.title: Bonus Stage available to everyone! - Update 0.8.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

A new update to the Ronny's Climb Demo just dropped which made the previously secret bonus stage available to everyone! Again, this "bonus" stage is a complete level with new mechanics, 100 gems to collect, and new achievements to unlock! The demo stage will automatically start after the official end of the demo. If you have already completed the demo previously, you'll find the demo in the stage selection screen.

There are also a few other changes as part of this update. Here is the full list:


 The bonus stage is now available to everyone! It will start automatically after the previous end of the demo. If you have already finished the demo, you'll find the bonus stage in the stage selection menu.
 Overview screen now includes progress on the bonus stage.
 Modified and added dialog relating to the end of the demo.
 Reduced the par time for stage 1 to make it slightly more challenging.
 Adapted the screen shake effects to make them less visually taxing for some players.
 Made stalagtites easier to dodge.
 Added a badge graphic to the stage selection UI.
 Added 'additional thanks' section to the credits.
 Fixed a sound bug when stalagtites hit the ground.


Feedback is always appreciated! ^-^ I wish you all a wonderful day and a lot of fun with the new stage!

notes.title: Secret Bonus Stage! - Update 0.7.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I just released an update to the Ronny's Climb Demo, which includes the secret demo stage I've teased before. I’m calling it a "bonus" stage because it’s not part of the main storyline, but really, it’s a complete level with new mechanics, 100 gems to collect, and new achievements to unlock!

As previously announced, this demo stage will be exclusive to a few selected creators and subscribers of the fan club for a short while. So, keep an eye out for Ronny's Climb streams or subscribe to the mailing list if you want to play it right now! Everyone else will get to play it around the beginning of December.

Here’s the full list of changes:


 Added a secret bonus stage; subscribe to ronnys-climb.com for hints on how to gain access.
 Changed and shortened the end-of-demo dialogue.
 Made a minor adaptation to Stage 3.
 Updated some animations.

notes.title: End of Steam Next Fest and Update 0.6.8
notes.content:
Heya all!

Steam Next Fest is over, and I just want to take a moment to thank everyone for the overwhelming support during the event. I'm blown away by how many of you have wishlisted, played, streamed, and reviewed Ronny's Climb. You all made this week an absolute joy, and I can't wait for the full release next year!

So, what’s next? First of all, the demo of Ronny's Climb will remain available at least until the full version launches, and I’ll continue to support it with updates. Even better, in November, I’ll be adding a full bonus stage to the demo! It’ll be exclusive at first to a few selected creators and subscribers of the fan club (if you’re not subscribed yet, you can sign up here ^-^). Later on, I’ll make it available for everyone.

In the meantime, here’s update 0.6.8, which adds a little extra content and fixes several bugs and annoyances discovered during Steam Next Fest:


 Adjusted various sections in all stages to remove sources of frustration, like gems becoming unreachable after moving stone blocks and Ronny sometimes being unable to backtrack to earlier areas.
 Added NPCs with new dialogue to Stage 3.
 Enabled chaining multiple dashes in quick succession.
 Increased the speed at which Ronny pushes stone blocks.
 Made movement on slopes more fluent.
 Tweaked dash behavior to prevent Ronny from barely getting stuck on ledges while dashing.
 Improved contrast and visuals in dark cave sections.
 Fixed a visual bug that occurred while pushing stone blocks.
 Fixed a bug where restarting Stage 3 would load Stage 1 instead.
 Fixed an issue where sounds would temporarily no longer play in stage 3.

notes.title: Update 0.6.4 and News regarding Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Heya everyone,

Hope you're all having a wonderful day. I have just pushed another update for the demo of Ronny's Climb, but before we go into the changes, some words about Steam Next Fest:

As you might or might not know, Ronny's Climb is participating in Steam Next Fest October which starts... tomorrow! If you like Ronny's Climb and want to support the development of the game, now is the time. Tell your friends and family. Wishlist the game if you haven't done so yet. Or leave a review if you're feeling particularly kind. Everything helps to get word of the game out there.

There's also a small teaser I have in store for you: I have decided to expand the scope of the demo by adding a bonus stage. That's right, another full stage for you to play even before the game releases! It will unlock with a future update coming soonish. Members of the Fan Club will be the first to know, so if you want to be among those people, this might be a good time to subscribe - it's free!

Finally, here is the change log for update 0.6.4:

 Reaching a checkpoint now restores all missing hearts.
 Dashing is now also possible using the SHIFT key.
 Added some new sounds.
 Just barely not reaching a ledge will now give the player a tiny push to help them make the jump.
 Reworked some sections where the player could barely not reach a life-saving platform after falling into a spike pit.
 Improved visuals for moving platforms and fixed jittering.
 Fixed a bug where flickering could occur during the death animation.

notes.title: Ronny's Climb Demo - Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
Heya, Zephyrix here! I want to give a big thank you to the whole community around Ronny's Climb. The days leading up to and the week following the release of the demo have been an absolute blast! From streamers covering the game to people doing speedruns and uploading them to YouTube, it was incredibly fun to watch you play my game and you were all very kind and helpful with feedback. A heartfelt thank you to everyone who streamed, reviewed, wishlisted, or simply played Ronny's Climb.

Here are a few changes and fixes I just pushed for update 0.5.1:


 Improved long jump behaviour after stomping enemies
 Added atmospheric sounds to Treetop Trails
 Added some new and missing credits entries
 Fixed cause of accidentially triggering the ground pound when using the analog stick
 Fixed window size resetting after returning to main menu
 Fixed sounds sometimes playing incorrectly after leaving or restarting a stage
 Fixed a bug causing invincibility after finishing the initial demo playthrough
